description: This Java source file defines the `Field` class, which models a data field with properties such as name, offset, type, bit offset, and options. It includes methods for command generation, parsing responses, and managing field instances.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a configurable data field with specific properties and command generation capabilities.
